Thomas Joseph Givnish (born May 14, 1951) is an American botanist , ecologist , and evolutionary biologist , holder of the Henry Allan Gleason Chair in Botany and Environmental Studies at the University of Wisconsin . [ 1 ] He has written extensively on speciation , adaptive radiation , and determinants of diversity in several plant groups, including Bromeliaceae , Rapateaceae , Orchidaceae as well as the Hawaiian lobelioids .
